scenario: A customer checks out a 499 SEK order (total_ore 49900) and pays; they should get 499 loyalty points

links.note: the event name is built from the model's kind, and the handler is registered by a decorator in a plugin imported by name from settings; should be cited or marked guessed

bugs.summary: Points are awarded on every save of an order: twice per checkout, and again on each admin note
bugs.detail: checkout saves the order while pending and again once paid; both pass the status check, so 499 SEK earns 998 points. app/web/admin.py:10 saves a paid order when a note is added, awarding 499 more each time.
